title: Headless TTW A Meeting of the Minds (DLC04MQ05a, Desmond's side): from Desmond at the lighthouse through Calvert's lab to the Brain's pod destroyed (stage 200, quest completed)

actions.text: Given: the player out of Vault 101 (MQ01 10) and Point Lookout's quests done up to Thought Control with the jammer installed (DLC04MQ01 to MQ04 200, PlayerInstalledJammer 1: their chains). DLC04MQ04's stage 200 (its first entry, the jammer installed and not destroyed) sets DLC04MQ05a 10 [observed]; done here directly so this chain runs alone. Stage 10 puts Desmond at the lighthouse [observed]. The player stands on Point Lookout's landing.

Path (Desmond's side): Desmond at the lighthouse (DLC04MQ04DesmondST10Greeting1, 1b: stage 50, follow him), the lighthouse and its secret door down to Calvert's lab, Desmond into the Brain's chamber (DLC04MQ05DoorTrigger02SCRIPT: 75, the doors lock), the Brain's demand (DLC04MQ05BrainBASEGreeting: 100) and the player's refusal (1b, 1b2: 102, the robots wake), and the Brain's pod destroyed (DLC04TheBrainScript: destruction stage 7, then 200: the quest done, Desmond's reward). The other choices: Desmond killed for the Brain (101, 150, 201).

Stand-in for the mansion's explosion at DLC04MQ04's end (DLC04MQ04ExplosionControlSCRIPT, its stage 17: DLC04MansionParentMarker 0x0E005A2B disabled, DLC04MansionDebris01 enabled, DLC04Generic.MansionDestroyed 1 [observed: decompiled SCPT 0x0E005A2F]; DLC04MQ05a's own stage-0 entry does the same disable [observed]). Stage 10 moves Desmond to DLC04MS05aDesmendWaitForPlayerLighthouseDUPLICATE000, in DLC04PanicRoom [observed: decode, headless trace], whose only way in from outside is the hatch 0x0E011D64 (persistent, no EDID; XTEL to the panic room's hatch 0x0E011D85), enabled opposite to that parent marker [observed: decode XESP]. With the mansion standing the hatch is not there.
Travel stand-in: to the mansion's ruins and down the hatch into the panic room, where Desmond waits.

actions.label: the hatch into the panic room
desmond: that bastard killed my pups

actions.text: The lighthouse's door (DLC04LighthouseDoorSCRIPT) and the secret door inside (DLC04LighthouseSecretDoorSCRIPT: it opens once 50 is done, Desmond with the player) [observed]; down into Calvert's lab.

Travel stand-in: through the lab to the Brain's chamber, Desmond along (the AI's follow). The player and Desmond enter its outer trigger (DLC04MQ05DoorTrigger01SCRIPT: doorentered) and Desmond the inner one (DLC04MQ05DoorTrigger02SCRIPT: his confrontation line, the doors locked, 75) [observed].

Stand-in for the Brain's talk: the Brain is a talking activator (DLC04TheBrain, TACT, voice type in its VNAM) and DLC04MQ05a's dialogue is held to the voice types its quest conditions name (GetIsVoiceType, ORed) [observed]; the runner reads voice types of actors only (Game::voice_type_of), so the Brain has no line to say (no_line on GREETING) [observed]. The lines the talk would bring are said as said lines: its greeting (end: stage 100), the player's 'why should I' and refusal (DLC04MQ05BrainBASEGreeting1b2, end: the Brain turns on both, 102).

Stand-in for the fight: the lab's robots wake (DLC04TheBrainScript) and the player shoots the Brain's pod (DLC04TheBrain DEST: health 300, seven stages) until it breaks; headless the shots are DamageObject for its whole health. At destruction stage 7 the script bursts the pod, the Brain's last words, and after 5 s sets 200 (150 not done: Desmond alive) [observed].

actions.label: the pod's destruction stage (6: the last index)

actions.text: Stand-in for the pod's burst: the pod is at its last destruction stage, but the runner's GetDestructionStage gives the stage's index (0 to 6) where the script waits for 7 (the DSTD damage stages of DLC04TheBrain run 1 to 7) [observed], so the burst step never runs; its own variables are set as that step sets them (destroyonce 1, explode 1, timer 5), and the script's countdown goes on to 200.
